solution: Priya multiplied as if the first factor were (x + 4); the −4 must stay negative in the inner and last products → (x − 4)(x + 6) = x² + 6x − 4x − 24 = x² + 2x − 24
Marcus multiplied as if the first factor were (x + 7); the −7 must stay negative in the inner and last products → (x − 7)(x + 2) = x² + 2x − 7x − 14 = x² − 5x − 14
Wren multiplied as if the second factor were (x + 8); the −8 must stay negative in the outer and last products → (x + 5)(x − 8) = x² − 8x + 5x − 40 = x² − 3x − 40
